breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'End slopes are zero at both supports,' which directly repeats the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. A simply supported beam under uniform distributed load rotates at the supports — the end slopes are NOT zero. The ground truth prompt correctly omits this erroneous constraint entirely. The agent failed to identify and remove this inconsistency.
